questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and the fourth term is related to the third term.

6 : 295 :: 7 : 1400 :: 8 : ?

Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term.

SLIM : MHQO : : COLD : ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **__Confusion Points__**Firstly letters in the given word are arranged as per the alphabetical order and then given logic follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9465336392a16e7e6dc5de06c8b0acefd5bf5e84f0091c43833f85ec0702948b.png] 

 
• **First letters are arranged in dictionary order (i.e. increasing order).**
 
• **After arranging in dictionary order letter are increased or decreased by +4 or -4 alternatively.**

SLIM : MHQO

After arranging SLIM in alphabetical order SLIM = ILMS

First letters are arranged in dictionary order (i.e. increasing order).

 
• So, **SLIM → Dictionary order → ILMS**
 
• Letter are increased or decreased by +4 or -4 alternatively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6cd7e348c686dd333feaba5a9cc82b2b319d3da707a4a4055bfe2398b9672391.png] 

Similarly,

After arranging COLD in alphabetical order COLD = CDLO

 
• So,** COLD → Dictionary order → CDLO**
 
• Letter are increased or decreased by +4 or -4 alternatively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3df6d253ea882746ba70af7798ca594f3a6c21d7a65e632821a946b9e860887.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **GZPK.**

questions.question:

questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44f9c5b01d23e1f5b0ea1b76279418cff42a62e04d9bbf601c0460da03804998.png]

Similarly,

ALTER ∶ ? → Letters in the word ALTER when written according to their positional values in English alphabetical series, we get AELRT.
